privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1body: The controller of your personal data is André Gutto (andre@andregutto.com). This system is strictly for personal and private use.
privacy.s2body: We collect: email address (for authentication), first and last name (provided voluntarily), country of residence, and personal financial data entered by you (assets, contributions, transactions). No data is obtained from third parties without your consent.
privacy.s3body: Your data is processed exclusively to operate the portfolio tracker. Legal basis: consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) for optional profile data; legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) for data required for the service to function.
privacy.s4body: Your data is kept as long as your account is active. Upon requesting account deletion, all personal data will be erased within 30 days.
privacy.s5body: Your data is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties. The service uses the Supabase platform (infrastructure hosted in the European Union) for secure storage.
privacy.s6body: You have the right to: access your personal data; rectify it; request erasure ("right to be forgotten"); restrict processing; obtain data portability; object to processing. To exercise these rights, please contact us at the email address below.
privacy.s7body: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All data is transmitted via HTTPS.
privacy.s8body: If you reside in France, you have the right to file a complaint with the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés) at cnil.fr if you believe your personal data is not being processed in accordance with the GDPR.
privacy.s9body: For any questions regarding this policy or the processing of your data, please contact: andre@andregutto.com
privacy.s10body: You can export all your financial data at any time in CSV or JSON format directly from the platform. Access to your data is guaranteed regardless of your account status.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.s1body: Arvo (arvo.andregutto.com) is a personal investment tracking tool provided by André Gutto free of charge for private use.
termsPage.s2body: The service is intended exclusively for the personal use of the account holder. Use for commercial purposes, redistribution, or sharing of access credentials is prohibited.
termsPage.s3body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the data you enter. Information displayed is calculated from data you provide and public sources. It does not constitute financial, tax, or legal advice.
termsPage.s4body: The service is provided without guarantee of continuous availability. Interruptions may occur for maintenance or technical reasons.
termsPage.s5body: All elements of the system (code, design, text) are the property of André Gutto unless otherwise indicated. No part may be reproduced without authorization.
termsPage.s6body: The service provider is not liable for investment decisions made based on the information displayed. Use of the system is at the user's own risk.
termsPage.s7body: These terms may be updated periodically. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of this page.
termsPage.s8body: These terms are governed by French law (loi n° 2004-575 du 21 juin 2004 for confidence in the digital economy) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
termsPage.s9body: For any questions, please contact: andre@andregutto.com
termsPage.s10body: Arvo is available free of charge during the beta period. In the future, a subscription may be required to access the platform. Regardless of the access model, all your financial data will always be available for download at any time.

landing.eyebrow: For Brazilians living abroad · Free Beta
landing.heroPara: Consolidate B3 stocks, FIIs, crypto, fixed income and European investments in one dashboard. Track performance, manage budgets with envelopes, plan your path to financial independence, and ask your portfolio anything in plain language.
landing.heroParaMobile: Consolidate your Brazilian and European investments, track spending, and chat with your portfolio, all in one place.
landing.assurance: Free during beta · No credit card · Data in the European Union
landing.featH2: Built for investors on both sides of the Atlantic
landing.f1desc: B3 stocks, ETFs, crypto, fixed income, real estate and FIIs, with live quotes and performance history.
landing.f2desc: Wealth in BRL, EUR and USD consolidated in your preferred currency. Automatic FX, no spreadsheet.
landing.f3desc: Create a Moment for your trip, renovation, or birthday: set a budget, attach the spending, and see exactly how much has been used. Share with a link. No spreadsheet.
landing.f4desc: Set a target capital or desired passive income. See your month-by-month trajectory and know when you will get there.
landing.f5desc: Ask in natural language: "How much did I invest in fixed income this year?" or "What was my biggest expense in October?"
landing.f6desc: Create expense groups with your partner, family or friends. Set goals per category, split proportionally, and see who spent what, without mixing personal finances.
landing.f5mockQ: What dragged my portfolio down in May?
landing.f5mockA: In May, BTC fell 8.2% and represented 12% of the portfolio, with an impact of −R$ 2,340. BOVA11 offset with +R$ 1,890.
landing.s1desc: Sign up in under two minutes. Choose your main currency and configure asset classes.
landing.s2desc: Stocks, FIIs, crypto, fixed income, real estate. Automatic quotes via B3, Yahoo Finance and CoinGecko.
landing.s3desc: Dashboard with consolidated wealth, real returns, class allocation and historical evolution.
landing.philoQuote: Built by a Brazilian in France, for those with assets in more than one country who need a clear view of everything.
landing.a1: Yes. The tracker is in beta and is completely free. Create your account and get started now.
landing.a2: Your data is stored on servers in the European Union via Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security). We never sell or share your information.
landing.q3: What types of investments can I track?
landing.a3: B3 stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, fixed income (CDB, Tesouro, LCI/LCA), FIIs, pension funds, real estate and manual assets with custom values.
landing.q4: Does it work for Brazilians abroad?
landing.a4: That is exactly what it was built for. Created by a Brazilian in France, arvo consolidates Brazilian and European assets in one view, with support for BRL, EUR and USD.
landing.a5: Yes. Upload a CSV and the system automatically imports your transactions for categorization and budget control.
landing.a6: arvo is a PWA (Progressive Web App) that works on your phone via the browser, with an experience close to a native app.
landing.ctaH2: No more spreadsheets. Start with clarity.
landing.ctaPara: Sign up in under 2 minutes. No credit card. Free during beta.
landing.f7desc: Plan trips with a budget per category, link real expenses and split costs with your travel companions. All connected to your finances.
landing.f8title: Learn from people on the same path
landing.f8desc: A members-only space to exchange experiences about investing between Brazil and Europe: taxes, brokers, relocation and financial life abroad.
landing.mkCommPost1t: How to declare investments in Europe while living abroad?
landing.mkCommPost1a: After 3 years in France, I finally understood how the exit declaration works…
landing.mkCommPost2a: I compared custody and FX fees across the main available options…
landing.mkCommPost3t: Is it worth keeping Brazilian REITs while abroad?
landing.mkCommPost3a: I ran the numbers on withholding tax versus European dividends…
landing.heroSub: Brazil and Europe in a single view: investments, spending, trips and community.
landing.logosCap: Works with the main institutions in Brazil and Europe
landing.actsH2: One tool for your entire financial life.

landing.a1d: B3, Europe and crypto with automatic FX, and performance computed on your position.
landing.a2t: Life together and the next trip
landing.a2d: Envelope budgets, shared expenses and planned trips, no spreadsheet.
landing.a3t: Build the itinerary, see it on the map

diversification.title: Diversification Scanner
diversification.subtitle: Geographic, sector and risk analysis of your portfolio
diversification.geoDesc: Portfolio concentration by country or region
diversification.sectorDesc: Concentration by economic sector: banks, energy, technology, retail...
diversification.hhiDesc: The HHI (Herfindahl-Hirschman Index) measures concentration from 0 (fully diversified) to 1 (everything in a single asset). The calculation uses the normalized HHI: it automatically adjusts thresholds to the number of available categories, giving a fair reading regardless of portfolio size.
diversification.effectiveNDesc: Equivalent number of equal-weight assets that would represent the same diversification level (1 / HHI).
diversification.riskScoreDesc: Weighted average by class value (simplified 1–5 scale).
diversification.hhiExplain: Originally developed to measure market concentration in antitrust analysis (USA, 1945), the HHI was adapted for finance. Formula: HHI = Σ(si²), where si is the fractional weight of each position. Normalized HHI = (HHI − 1/n) ÷ (1 − 1/n), where n is the number of categories. 0% = perfectly equal distribution; 100% = everything in a single position.
diversification.sectorFallbackNote: Sector data unavailable for some assets, showing by asset class as fallback
diversification.riskMethodologyDesc: Score = portfolio average weighted by class value. Simplified scale: Cash = 1 · Fixed Income = 2 · Real Estate / REITs = 3 · Stocks / ETFs = 4 · Crypto = 5. This is an indicative classification created for this app, it is not a regulated risk model. Risk within the same class (e.g., individual stocks) is not captured.
diversification.riskByClassTitle: Allocation and risk level by class
diversification.riskBarNote: Bars show % of portfolio; colors indicate the risk level of each class
